label: Youngs et al. (1997)
units: PGA, SA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are partial - not even the anchor branch is complete - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Youngs et al. (1997)

site.anchor_note: Resolved from the two reported constant sets.

mechanism.note: Event type carries the source distinction, not a mechanism flag.

event_type.note: Must be supplied by the caller. Do NOT classify from depth unless the caller explicitly requests the paper's own depth-based fallback rule.

coefficients.needed: INCOMPLETE even for PGA. The appendix reports rock (C1 0.2418, C2 1.414, C3 -2.552, C4 ln(1.7818), C8 0.3846, C9 0.00607) and deep-soil (C1 -0.6687, C2 1.438, C3 -2.329, C4 ln(1.097), C5 0.3643, C9 0.00648) constants, but states that other coefficients needed for more general site prediction are not given. The event-type (interface/intraslab) term is not among the reported values. Do not assume it.

implementation_notes: Test interface vs intraslab at identical Mw, distance and site - they must differ.

reproduction.incomplete_note: Partial: the reported constants do not cover the event-type term, so neither branch can be evaluated from the appendix alone.

resolution_provenance.component: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table) and Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table): component code G; OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/youngs_1997.py declares IMC.GEOMETRIC_MEAN (p. 59)
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/youngs_1997.py coefficient table; period count and range (11 periods, 0.075-3 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked. The OpenQuake tables carry an extra 4.0 s row; Douglas counts 11 periods ending at 3 s, so 4.0 s is excluded pending the paper.
